name: unsafe fn pre_exec < F > (& mut self , f : F) -> & mut process :: Command where F : FnMut () -> io :: Result < () > + Send + Sync + 'static
rule: The caller must ensure that f does not violate library invariants through invalid use of resources duplicated by fork, including file descriptors and memory-mapped regions.
